_comment: WP2 local sources: file, webcam, camera enumeration
source.file.name: Video or image file
source.file.desc: Use a video file, a single image, or a folder of images as a camera. Handy for practice and testing without a camera.
source.file.err.no_path: No file chosen yet. Pick a video, an image, or a folder of images.
source.file.err.not_found: Cannot find "{path}". Check that the file or folder still exists and was not renamed.
source.file.err.unsupported: "{name}" is not a supported file. Use a video (mp4, avi, mov, mkv, webm), an image (jpg, png, bmp), or a folder of images.
source.file.err.empty_folder: The folder "{path}" has no images (jpg, png, bmp...).
source.file.hint.video_open: The file may be damaged or in a format this computer cannot play. Try converting it to mp4 (H.264) or avi (MJPG).
source.file.err.not_open: The file source is not open.
source.file.msg.unsupported: This source has no setting called "{key}".
source.file.msg.step_need_pause: Press Pause first, then you can step one frame at a time.
source.webcam.name: Computer camera (USB or built-in)
source.webcam.desc: A laptop's built-in camera, a USB camera, or an iPhone Continuity Camera. The first time, the computer may ask whether to allow camera access.
source.webcam.err.no_frame: The camera (number {index}) opened but no picture is coming in.
source.webcam.err.linux_perm: No permission to use the camera device {path}.
source.webcam.err.disconnected: The camera picture stopped. The USB cable may have been unplugged.
source.webcam.hint.mac: The first time, a permission window pops up: click Allow, then press Retry. If no window appears, go to System Settings > Privacy & Security > Camera and allow Terminal (or the program you used to start EdgeLens), then press Retry.
source.webcam.hint.win: Another program may be using the camera (such as Teams, LINE, Zoom, or the Camera app). Close it and press Retry. Also check Settings > Privacy & security > Camera and allow desktop apps to use the camera.
source.webcam.hint.linux_missing: Check that the USB cable is plugged in and the camera number is correct.
source.webcam.hint.linux_perm: Add yourself to the video group: sudo usermod -aG video $USER, then log out and back in and press Retry. (Device: {path})
source.webcam.hint.generic: Check that the USB cable is plugged in and no other program is using the camera, then press Retry.
source.webcam.hint.replug: Plug the USB cable in again (unplug and replug), then press Retry.
source.webcam.msg.unsupported: This camera has no setting called "{key}".
source.webcam.msg.set_failed: The camera did not accept this setting.
source.webcam.msg.not_accepted: The setting was sent, but the camera reports a different value. This value may not be usable.
source.webcam.msg.turn_off_auto: Turn off the matching Auto option first, otherwise manual adjustment has no effect.
source.webcam.msg.reopen_failed: Reopening the camera with the new setting failed. Went back to the previous setting.
source.webcam.msg.res_changed: The camera does not support this resolution and used the closest one.
source.webcam.note.mac_no_controls: macOS exposes almost no controls such as brightness or contrast. This is normal; only resolution and frames per second can be changed here.
